packages.name: client
packages.doc: Package client defines the public AgentK client API.

types.name: Client
types.doc:
Client provides transport-independent access to the AgentK API. Create a
Client with a transport package such as client/grpc.

methods.name: CancelExecution
methods.doc: CancelExecution requests cancellation of the running Execution in a Session.

methods.name: CreateSession
methods.doc:
CreateSession creates a Session from the complete Profile in request. The
Profile is fixed for the lifetime of the Session.

methods.name: GetExecution
methods.doc:
GetExecution returns one Execution identified by its Session and Execution
IDs.

methods.name: InvokeCapability
methods.doc:
InvokeCapability invokes a registered capability without creating a Session
or Execution and waits for its result.

methods.name: ListCapabilities
methods.doc:
ListCapabilities returns a page of registered capabilities, ordered by
capability ID.

methods.name: ListEvents
methods.doc:
ListEvents returns a page of persisted Session events, ordered from newest to
oldest.

methods.name: ListExecutions
methods.doc:
ListExecutions returns a page of Executions for a Session, ordered from newest
to oldest.

methods.name: ListPipelines
methods.doc:
ListPipelines returns a page of Pipelines available to a Session, ordered by
name.

methods.name: ListSessions
methods.doc: ListSessions returns a page of Sessions, ordered from newest to oldest.

methods.name: StartExecution
methods.doc:
StartExecution starts an Execution in an existing Session using the input in
request and returns the new Execution.

methods.name: WatchEvents
methods.doc:
WatchEvents opens a live stream for the Session and Execution named in
request. The caller must receive from and close the returned stream.

methods.name: WhoAmI
methods.doc: WhoAmI returns the service and App identity resolved by AgentK.

types.name: EventStream
types.doc:
EventStream receives live event frames for one Session and Execution. Call
Receive in a loop, inspect Msg after each successful receive, and check Err
when Receive returns false.

methods.name: Close
methods.doc:
Close stops receiving and releases the stream resources. Call Close when the
stream is no longer needed, including when iteration ends early.

methods.name: Err
methods.doc: Err returns the first non-EOF receive error after Receive returns false.

methods.name: Msg
methods.doc:
Msg returns the frame from the most recent successful call to Receive. The
returned message must not be used after the next call to Receive.

methods.name: Receive
methods.doc:
Receive advances the stream to the next frame and reports whether a frame is
available. When it returns false, call Err to distinguish a clean end from a
receive failure.

types.name: Options
types.doc: Options configures an AgentK client created by a transport package.

packages.name: grpc
packages.doc: Package grpc connects to AgentK over gRPC using KESS service discovery.

funcs.name: New
funcs.doc:
New creates an AgentK Client that uses unencrypted HTTP/2 gRPC. It connects
directly to options.Endpoint when set, or uses KESS service discovery
otherwise.
